# zinn_dns_record (Resource)

A DNS record on a domain hosted in your organisation's DNS. Import with `<domain_id>/<record_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "zinn_domains" "all" {}

resource "zinn_dns_record" "www" {
  domain_id = one([for d in data.zinn_domains.all.domains : d.id if d.fqdn == "example.com"])
  name      = "www"
  type      = "CNAME"
  value     = "example.com."
  ttl       = 3600
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) Id of the domain (see `zinn_domains`).
- `name` (String) Record name, e.g. `www` or `@`.
- `type` (String) Record type, e.g. `A`, `CNAME`, `TXT`, `MX`.
- `value` (String) Record value.

### Optional

- `priority` (Number) Priority, for MX and SRV records.
- `proxied` (Boolean) Serve through the CDN proxy, where the zone supports it.
- `ttl` (Number) TTL in seconds; the API default when unset.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Record id.
- `owner` (String) Who manages the record (you or the platform).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import zinn_dns_record.www <domain_id>/<record_id>
```
